ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   A. Copy random text without understanding Conversational Skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Conversational Skills.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational Skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational Skills.
